answer: Anchor each identity to a sequential delay chain: each epoch the network publishes a random seed, and every agent must run a verifiable delay function on it taking ten real minutes on one core. Adding cores cannot speed it up, so a whisper of a thousand fake names needs a thousand cores burning ten minutes each. The chain is ferrous: its output is branded on the identity, and a forged result is caught instantly. One honest agent pays ten minutes; a farm pays ten thousand core-minutes per epoch, plus the ivory cost of idle hardware. Sybils stop being cheap when time itself is the toll.
